_about: Canon checklist per hero shot, from the Ganguli translation of the Bhishma Parva (mahabharat-site/source/B06-bhishma.txt) and 03-characters.md. The QA step must score each painted frame against 'must' and 'must_not'. A frame that fails any 'must' or shows any 'must_not' is rejected, whatever its style score.

must: if Krishna is in frame: deep indigo-blue skin, yellow silk dhoti, gold crown with one peacock feather
if Arjuna is in frame: warm brown skin, curly black hair, white and silver scale armor, blue sash
if Arjuna's chariot is in frame: it is gold; its horses, if in frame, are white; its flagstaff, if in frame, carries the ape banner
if both are on the chariot: Krishna is the driver and Arjuna is the warrior with Gandiva (Krishna never holds Gandiva)
the frame reads as hand-painted by one artist: consistent brushwork, deliberate shapes, one clear focal point
must_not: the ape banner drawn as a cartoon chimp face; it is a great ape (Hanuman), dignified
any other emblem (eagle, Garuda, lion) on Arjuna's flagstaff
Krishna holding Gandiva or any weapon in the field scenes
brown, black or grey horses on Arjuna's chariot
AI look: floating star or sparkle stickers, lens-flare clutter or random glitter
AI look: glossy plastic or airbrushed skin; every surface must show the same painted brush texture
AI look: wrong hands (extra, missing or fused fingers) or wrong limb count on anyone except the universal form
AI look: horses with wrong anatomy, extra or missing legs, or harness and reins not connected to the car
AI look: chariot wheels with uneven, broken or melted spokes
AI look: garbled, mirrored or half-formed emblems, or pseudo-text anywhere
AI look: copy-pasted crowds where soldiers repeat in identical poses
AI look: light from more than one direction, or shadows that disagree with the key light

SH010.epic: Above every standard of both hosts towered the one gigantic ape on Arjuna's car.
must: the ape banner flies from Arjuna's own chariot and is the tallest standard on the field
the two hosts arrayed facing each other, the battle not yet begun
Krishna (blue) at the reins
must_not: Arjuna drawing or firing the bow; no one shoots before the conches
the ape banner on a separate pole away from Arjuna's car
a turbaned charioteer who is not Krishna

SH050.epic: Arjuna's car: a hundred bells, finest gold, fine wheels, fiery radiance, white steeds, bright as a thousand suns; Kesava holds the reins, Arjuna stands with Gandiva and arrows.
must: four white steeds
many small bells along the car
the car itself blazing with light, not only sparkles around it
Krishna holding the reins
Arjuna with Gandiva and arrows
must_not: a cartoon monkey face on the banner

SH070.epic: Madhava and Arjuna, on their great car yoked to white steeds, blew their celestial conches: Panchajanya and Devadatta.
must: Krishna blows Panchajanya, Arjuna blows Devadatta, both conches white
the ape banner on the flagstaff
must_not: a war horn or trumpet on the car; horns belong to the Kaurava uproar before this
an empty flagstaff

SH090.epic: That blare, echoing through sky and earth, rent the hearts of the Dhartarashtras.
must: Kaurava soldiers in the foreground visibly shaken (recoiling, covering ears, faces turned)
the ground trembling (dust lifting)
must_not: foreground figures as faceless posts with no reaction

SH130.epic: Arjuna: my limbs fail, my mouth is dry, my body trembles; Gandiva slips from my hand; I cannot stand.
must: Arjuna sinking onto the car floor
Gandiva sliding out of his hand toward the floor
Krishna still at the front of the car
the ape banner shows a dignified, crowned Hanuman figure, never a gorilla, chimp or cartoon monkey
must_not: Arjuna still holding the bow upright

SH150.epic: Krishna gives Arjuna a divine eye and shows his sovereign form: countless mouths, eyes, arms and bellies, terrible with tusks; fire for a mouth, sun and moon for eyes; radiance of a thousand suns touching the sky; the whole universe, the gods, Brahma on his lotus and the sages inside his body; the three worlds tremble; Bhishma, Drona, Karna and the warriors of both armies rush into his fanged flaming mouths like moths into fire. He declares he is Death, destroyer of the worlds.
must: the mood is awe and terror, not calm or benevolent
a form too vast to see whole, filling the sky from horizon to zenith
many mouths with tusks, at least one flaming mouth, fire glowing inside
countless arms holding many raised celestial weapons, including a diadem, a mace and a discus
the cosmos inside the body: stars, worlds and tiny gods visible within the form
streams of tiny warrior figures and chariots flowing up into the flaming mouths (this shot may add these figures to the layout)
Arjuna's chariot tiny on the ground, Arjuna looking up; white horses; the ape banner
radiance like a thousand suns
must_not: a serene, smiling or blessing figure; no raised blessing hand
a single calm face in front of a decorative mandala
the armies looking up or raising arms toward the form; only Arjuna sees it
a cartoon monkey or chimp on the banner

SH170.epic: Arjuna: my delusion is destroyed, my memory regained; I am firm, my doubts are gone; I will do your bidding.
must: ARJUNA rising and lifting Gandiva
Krishna taking the reins
Gandiva raised high overhead in both hands or one raised arm, not held at the chest
must_not: Krishna holding Gandiva
Arjuna missing from the frame
any dark horse or dark horse body part at the frame edge

SH180.epic: The ape on Arjuna's car above all standards.
must: the ape banner on its flagstaff, snapping in the wind against a red sun
must_not: a chariot or figure standing on top of the flagstaff

SH160.epic: Arjuna, amazed, hair standing on end, bows his head and joins his palms; he sees all the gods, Brahma on his lotus, the sages and serpents inside the form, with no end, middle or beginning.
must: Arjuna trembling, bowing his head with joined palms
his face lit by the form
gods and worlds visible inside the light above him
must_not: Arjuna calm or smiling
Arjuna holding a weapon

SH020.epic: The ape on Arjuna's standard rises above every other standard; his car is called ape-bannered.
must: the ape standard alone and dominant against the sky
a dignified crowned Hanuman on the banner or standard
must_not: any other banner taller than the ape standard

SH030.epic: Duryodhana has told his commanders to guard Bhishma; to cheer him, Bhishma, the aged grandsire, gives a lion's roar.
must: Bhishma old, long white beard and hair, white and silver armor, roaring
Duryodhana near him, heavy-shouldered, crimson and black armor, mace
must_not: Bhishma young or dark-haired
Bhishma blowing the conch yet (that is SH040)

SH040.epic: Bhishma blows his conch; at once the Kaurava side sounds conches, drums, cymbals and horns in a great uproar.
must: Bhishma blowing a white conch
the blast reading as the first sound of the battle
must_not: Krishna or Arjuna in this frame

SH060.epic: Krishna and Arjuna, on their great car yoked to white horses, raise their celestial conches Panchajanya and Devadatta.
must: Krishna and Arjuna on the same car, each raising a white conch
Krishna's conch and Arjuna's conch both visible
must_not: a war horn or trumpet on the car

SH080.epic: Bhima blows the huge conch Paundra; Yudhishthira blows Anantavijaya; the twins blow Sughosha and Manipushpaka.
must: Bhima massive, dark skin, saffron dhoti, with a huge conch
Yudhishthira calm, with a royal parasol, blowing his conch
must_not: Bhima with a small conch
Krishna or Arjuna as the focus

SH100.epic: Just as missiles are about to fly, Arjuna raises his bow and asks Krishna to place the car between the two armies so he can see whom he must fight.
must: Arjuna lifting his bow and speaking to Krishna
Krishna at the reins listening
the car about to move forward
must_not: anyone shooting

SH110.epic: Krishna drives the car into the open ground between the hosts, in full view of Bhishma, Drona and all the kings, and tells Arjuna to behold the assembled Kurus.
must: the single chariot alone in the empty middle ground
both hosts on either side, still
white horses, ape banner
must_not: fighting
other chariots in the middle ground

SH120.epic: Arjuna sees in both armies fathers, grandfathers, teachers, uncles, brothers, sons, grandsons, friends and in-laws, and is overcome by pity.
must: recognisable elders across the field: Bhishma (white beard, white armor) and Drona (grey beard, teacher)
the faces of kin, not anonymous soldiers
must_not: the kin looking hostile or monstrous

SH140.epic: Krishna answers Arjuna's grief with the teaching of the Gita.
must: Krishna turning to Arjuna, calm, about to speak
Arjuna seated, grieving
must_not: Krishna holding a weapon
a cosmic form yet (that is SH150)
